summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a May 20, 2026 news release announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report details the company's ESG performance, including an updated double materiality assessment, recognition on Corporate Knights' Global 100, MSCI AAA rating, and community investments of $9.4 million in 2025. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is disclosed. The filing is a routine sustainability disclosure by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a domestic press release on non-financial performance.
